nodes.label: Gold module prod recovery, 2026-05-10
nodes.rationale: Two distinct prod failures resolved the same night: a build failure from a file on disk that was never git added, and a runtime 'Failed to fetch import' caused by Neon being 18 migrations behind the deployed code.

nodes.label: Migration history drift from prisma db push
nodes.rationale: The team applied schema changes to Neon with db push, so the DDL was mostly present but _prisma_migrations was 18 records behind. migrate deploy then failed with 'relation already exists', and one migration left in started-but-unfinished state blocked all future migrations.

nodes.label: db push banned against production
nodes.rationale: db push mutates the DB with no audit trail, so once any production-shaped DB exists only migrate dev and migrate deploy may run. Enforced in AGENTS.md, the gold-data-foundation charter, and a settings.json hook that blocks db push calls from agents.

nodes.label: Build script must run prisma migrate deploy
nodes.rationale: Named the single most important fix: the Vercel build container already holds the prod DATABASE_URL, so putting migrate deploy before next build costs 5–30s and stops every schema change risking a repeat outage.

nodes.label: Pre-deploy migration drift check
nodes.rationale: A CI/pre-push hook running prisma migrate diff with --exit-code; exit code 2 means drift exists and the push is blocked until a migration is created.

nodes.label: prisma migrate resolve recovery procedure
nodes.rationale: Marked the half-applied migration as applied, diffed Neon against the target schema (only 2174 bytes of strictly additive DDL), applied it via a direct pg client in one transaction because Prisma's db execute failed on the Neon pooler, then synced _prisma_migrations records with SHA-256 checksums.
